exclusion_reason: RFC 8439 limits a message to 2^38-64 bytes, so the length query past that limit is implementation-defined: Botan's output_length checks only size_t overflow and rejects the message when processing it, while the port's length guard rejects it at the query. Ruled an accepted divergence by the operator on 2026-10-20 (chainlink #48; oracle/divergences/boundary-aead-output-length-encrypt-0003).
